info.name: Clozd Data /programs/:program Id/touchpoints/:touchpoint ID /programs/:program Id/touchpoints/:touchpoint ID API

params.name: include
params.description: Specifies type of data to include with touchpoint. NOTE: Cannot include 'transcripts', 'surveyQuestions, or 'tags' without also including 'feedback' (maxItems:6)

params.name: program_id
params.description: Clozd program ID (min:36 chars, max:36 chars)

params.name: touchpoint_id
params.description: Clozd touchpoint ID (min:36 chars, max:36 chars)

items.docs:
Get a specific touchpoint with details (basic fields, extra fields, optional custom metadata fields, participants, published feedback responses, and full feedback transcript). Make sure the header is set with a key value pair being Key: x-api-token Value: (api token provided from the settings section within the Clozd application).
 - :program_id is required, you can get the program id from the settings page within the Clozd app. 
 - :touchpoint_id is required, see /programs/:program_id/touchpoin
